Class manageEmployeesController

java.lang.Object
manageEmployeesController
public class manageEmployeesController extends Object
The manageEmployeeController class will manage the employee information in the manager GUI. Right now it allows the manager to be able to view the employee schedule, add new employees, edit current employees and deactivate some. Also able to navigate across the classes.
